propositions: match_predicate(state, field, op, value) has a value parameter whose type depends on op (scalar for eq/lt/le/gt/ge, iterable for in, tuple for range), causing mypy errors when annotated as object and loss of contract clarity when widened to Any
PredicateValue union (str | AbstractSet[str] | tuple[str|None, str|None]) must be defined in _filters.py and returned from _parse_value to encode the operator-value relationship at type level
match_predicate body must narrow by construction using isinstance checks or per-field helpers extracted along tag/priority/string-field seams to reduce C901 complexity without introducing Any
rebar.reducer.* module must pass mypy src/rebar/reducer --disallow-untyped-defs cleanly and be promoted to tier-1 override in pyproject.toml and _RATCHET_BASELINE in tests/unit/test_mypy_ratchet.py
